name: CORS Preflight Inspector
description: Explains the Fetch CORS rules offline: whether a preflight is needed, an OPTIONS draft, per-stage preflight and response verdicts, and the headers scripts can actually read
help: Enter the page origin (or the literal null), the target URL, method, credentials mode and request headers; the tool only reasons offline and never sends a request.
Fill the preflight and actual responses separately (status + headers); leaving one empty yields "undetermined" instead of a guess.

Covers safelisted methods and headers (including the Content-Type value check), forbidden headers, ACAO/ACAC/ACAM/ACAH matching, wildcard restrictions with credentials, Authorization never covered by wildcards, duplicate or joined ACAO values, Expose-Headers and unreadable Set-Cookie.
Scope: a single fetch without redirects and without a preflight cache hit; CSP, mixed content, PNA, SameSite and extensions are not simulated. Verdicts are static reasoning, not a real browser run.

input.hint: Cookie / Authorization values are masked; cases stay in the session only
input.empty: Fill in the request context and press Inspect

result.title: Verdict
result.optionsHint: Sent by the browser automatically; Host and friends are browser-managed

outcome.same_origin: Same-origin request, CORS does not apply
outcome.forbidden_header: The browser forbids setting these headers, the request is never sent
outcome.unsupported_scheme: Target is not http(s), CORS does not apply
outcome.no_preflight: Simple request: sent and the response is readable
outcome.preflight_ok: Preflight passed: sent and the response is readable
outcome.preflight_failed: Preflight failed: the actual request is never sent
outcome.sent_but_unreadable: The actual request was sent, but the page cannot read the response
